// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-PARENT-CHILD-LINK
// Owner amendment C2 would permit this count. Handbook ruling R11 does not, and
// the gate implements R11 until the owner says otherwise. See the gate header.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function parentByEmail(email) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({
    where: { email },
    select: { id: true, createdAt: true, _count: { select: { children: true } } },
  });
}
